title: Alternative orbit-min key with resident branch products: secp256k1 cold-work bound125.252273153078

claims.statement: For uniform full-production secp256k1 Q=[x]P, the classical cold stored-leaf algorithm in proof.md, KEY_LEMMA.md and LEDGER_EVIDENCE.md recovers x with probability at least0.390000001 over the challenge and fresh algorithm coins. Total work on every run is at most2^125.252273153078 target-group-operation equivalents, C=1000 scalar AArch64 instructions. Exact ledger50663039813835494157123632379974059556864instructions includes all preprocessing, failures, metered arithmetic, two-hop transport, grouping, candidate recovery and output verification. Peak memory<=2^135.9988bytes, preprocessing<=2^110.1472units included, advice0. New key=min(Bx,Dx,-Ax) modp with bounded classifier-window errors; caps and success parameters are unchanged. This is an exploratory analytic bound, not a production execution or formal certificate.
